items.name: permission-editor
items.title: Permission Editor
items.description: A compact permission workspace with category navigation, individual action checkboxes, scoped data controls and accessible scope help.
items.docs: Map your permissions to sections of groups of rows; each row has an id, a label, an optional hint, whether it is enabled, and optionally the levels it can reach and the current one. onEnabledChange and onLevelChange report changes by row id. Every word comes through props, English by default. Resource groups render as compact rows with wrapping action checkboxes. Optional row.scopes bind independent scope selectors to their owning action. Actions are configured individually; category names and groups omit authorization counts and bulk selection. Filtering never mutates the draft. Use scope.hint for contextual scope help shown on hover, keyboard focus or tap, and labels.scopeHintFor for the accessible trigger name. Use group.accessOnly for a page with a single access action to show one title checkbox without redundant action text. Provide scope.configuration for parameterized scopes; PermissionFilter edits validated condition drafts and keeps role saving in the host form. Never save customFilter as a bare key: bind its native params.filter object.

items.name: role-list
items.title: Role List
items.description: A role administration table built with the standard DataTable: localized column headers, sortable names and identifiers, protected/custom badges, and pagination. The host supplies authorized rows and edit destinations. Preinstalled in both application templates.
items.docs: Render inside a React Router and the application i18n provider. Supply roles with key, localized title, edit destination (to) and protected state. Pass localized labels for name, key, type, protected and custom, plus an optional ariaLabel. Uses the shared DataTable for table semantics, sorting and pagination. Optional tableState accepts controlled pagination/sorting and page-size choices from the host URL adapter. The host owns loading, empty/error states, filtering and authorization. Existing apps must update the installed role-list component, its data-table dependency and caller labels together.

items.name: default-access-editor
items.title: Default Access Editor
items.description: Controlled default data scope rule fields with business-object selection, independent operation scopes and native custom-filter slots. The host supplies current rules and performs authorized writes. Preinstalled in both application templates.
items.docs: Pass localized labels, a stable rule key, resource choices and scope controls. Explain that default data scopes combine with role-granted scopes for users who already hold the operation permission, and that restriction rules still constrain final access. The host loads authorization/defaultAccess and authorization/defaultAccess/options, enforces settings:authorization.default-access read/create/update/delete, and owns draft preservation, custom filters, validation, confirmation and writes. Existing apps reconcile the editor, default-access pages/model/routes, locales and contextual role-form link from the updated template. No existing rule is seeded or rewritten on upgrade. Both templates expose one Permission management sidebar entry with Roles and permissions and Default data scopes tabs, without changing their route ids, URLs, settings guards or stored rules. This navigation organization does not add sharing or restriction editors.
